findings.comment: The buyer lookup in `recordBulk` hardcodes `purchaserID`, but every other purchase read branches on `PURCHASER_READ_SWAP` and falls back to `userID`. The `purchaserID` column can be null for rows written before the backfill ran, so with the switch off the fanout lookup misses older buyers.

finding_contract.current_impact: When the purchaser read swap switch is off and purchaserID is not populated, fanout may write a fan club unread row for a member who already bought the set.
finding_contract.falsifiable_condition: Run the request with a legacy row.
